Sitharaman Identifies China's Non-Tariff Barriers as Trade Hurdle

India's Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has stated that China's non-tariff barriers are the biggest obstacle hindering trade relations and preventing India from selling more goods to China. These barriers are identified as the primary challenge in the bilateral trade ties.
